DBE_841.title: Template doesn't start with double {
DBE_841.description: A template in the biography of the profile does not start with double curly brackets "{{". All WikiTree templates must start with double curly brackets.
DBE_841.description_raw: A template in the biography of the profile does not start with double curly brackets "{{". All WikiTree templates must start with double curly brackets.

DBE_842.title: Template doesn't end with double }
DBE_842.description: A template in the biography of the profile does not end with double curly brackets "}}". All WikiTree templates must end with double curly brackets.
DBE_842.description_raw: A template in the biography of the profile does not end with double curly brackets "}}". All WikiTree templates must end with double curly brackets.

DBE_843.title: Missing template (spelling)
DBE_843.description: There is an error in a template name in the biography of the profile. It could be a spelling mistake, a template that no longer exists, or not yet created.

DBE_844.title: Out of use template
DBE_844.description: A template in the biography of this profile is being misused, which may mean that the template is a base template and not used directly, the template is no longer active, or the template has been replaced.

DBE_845.title: Direct usage of base templates
DBE_845.description: The biography contains a base project template such as {{Project Box|etc}} or {{Sticker|etc}} that should be replaced with the appropriate specific template.

DBE_846.title: Died before template time frame
DBE_846.description: The template used in the biography has a time constraint. The death date on the profile is prior to the template date range.

DBE_847.title: Born after template time frame
DBE_847.description: The template used in the biography has a time constraint. The birth date on the profile is after the template date range.

DBE_848.title: Error in template parameters
DBE_848.description: A template in the biography has one or more unacceptable values. See the suggestion page for correct values.

DBE_891.title: Missing template (system)
DBE_891.description: Template is missing due to a spelling error, deletion, or it never existed.

DBE_892.title: Free-Space Profile page used as template
DBE_892.description: Free-Space Profile pages cannot be used as templates.

DBE_893.title: Free-Space Profile page used as transclusion
DBE_893.description: Free-Space Profile pages cannot be used for transclusion.

DBE_895.title: Using Deprecated parameter in template
DBE_895.description: Deprecated template parameters are present and should be removed.

DBE_896.title: Unknown parameter in template
DBE_896.description: Template contains an unknown (often mistyped or removed) parameter.

DBE_897.title: Error in template parameters
DBE_897.description: Template parameters are checked for validity; there is a validity error.

DBE_961.title: Invalid domain name in link
DBE_961.description: Domain name (DNS) in link is not formed correctly; the link leads to nowhere.

DBE_962.title: Domain name in the link is not resolved
DBE_962.description: The URL/domain cannot be resolved to an IP address (often due to typo, spaces in DNS, server removed/changed, or using an IP instead of DNS).

DBE_965.title: Link error 404 Not Found
DBE_965.description: The link points to a page that doesn't exist (typo, moved page, or removed page).

DBE_966.title: Link error - various
DBE_966.description: The link points to a server that doesn't exist; causes vary and can be temporary.

DBE_967.title: Link error in domain
DBE_967.description: The link points to a server that doesn't exist; causes vary and can be temporary.

DBE_971.title: Missing image
DBE_971.description: An image reference in biography/text/template points to a file that doesn't exist (typo, deleted image, or not uploaded).

DBE_571.title: FindAGrave - Link without Grave ID
DBE_571.description: Profile links to a Find A Grave memorial but the memorial number is missing.

DBE_572.title: FindAGrave - Link without matching Grave
DBE_572.description: Profile is linked to a non-existent Find A Grave memorial (deleted, merged, or never existed).

DBE_573.title: FindAGrave - Empty birth date
DBE_573.description: Find A Grave memorial has a birth date but the WikiTree profile has no birth date entered.

DBE_574.title: FindAGrave - Imprecise birth date
DBE_574.description: WikiTree has a birth date, but the Find A Grave memorial birth date is more exact.

DBE_575.title: FindAGrave - Different birth date
DBE_575.description: WikiTree birth date differs from the Find A Grave memorial birth date.

DBE_576.title: FindAGrave - Empty death date
DBE_576.description: Find A Grave memorial has a death date but the WikiTree profile has no death date entered.

DBE_577.title: FindAGrave - Imprecise death date
DBE_577.description: WikiTree has a death date, but the Find A Grave memorial death date is more exact.

DBE_578.title: FindAGrave - Different death date
DBE_578.description: WikiTree death date differs from the Find A Grave memorial death date (or death date is missing on WikiTree).

DBE_579.title: FindAGrave - Missing birth location
DBE_579.description: WikiTree birth location is missing; Find A Grave memorial has a suggested birth location.

DBE_581.title: FindAGrave - Missing death location
DBE_581.description: WikiTree death location is missing; Find A Grave memorial has a suggested death location.

DBE_585.title: FindAGrave - Multiple profiles link to same grave ID
DBE_585.description: Multiple WikiTree profiles link to the same Find A Grave memorial (possible family grouping or duplicate profiles).

DBE_586.title: FindAGrave - Link to merged Grave ID
DBE_586.description: WikiTree links to a memorial that has been merged into another memorial.

DBE_587.title: FindAGrave - Link to nonexistent Grave ID
DBE_587.description: WikiTree links to a memorial that is deleted/merged or otherwise incorrect.

DBE_591.title: FindAGrave - Possible father
DBE_591.description: Possible father suggested from linked memorial; father relationship missing in WikiTree.

DBE_592.title: FindAGrave - Possible mother
DBE_592.description: Possible mother suggested from linked memorial; mother relationship missing in WikiTree.

DBE_593.title: FindAGrave - Possible spouse
DBE_593.description: Possible spouse suggested from linked memorial; spouse relationship missing in WikiTree.

DBE_452.title: Profile completeness - Father Status not set
DBE_452.description: Father status was not set when the profile was created where there are children listed.

DBE_454.title: Profile completeness - Mother Status not set
DBE_454.description: Mother status is not set where there are children listed.

DBE_455.title: Profile completeness - Birth date not set

DBE_456.title: Profile completeness - Birth date Status not set
DBE_456.description: Birthdate status is not set where there is a date in the field.

DBE_457.title: Profile completeness - Birth Location not set

DBE_458.title: Profile completeness - Birth location Status not set
DBE_458.description: Birth location status is not set where there is a location shown.

DBE_459.title: Profile completeness - Birth location Country not recognised
DBE_459.description: Country in the birth location field isn't recognized (possible typo).

DBE_460.title: Profile completeness - Birth Location Country not official
DBE_460.description: Location is not entered in the official form for that country.

DBE_461.title: Profile completeness - Death date not set

DBE_462.title: Profile completeness - Death date Status not set
DBE_462.description: Deathdate status is not set where there is a date in the field.

DBE_463.title: Profile completeness - Death Location not set

DBE_464.title: Profile completeness - Death location Status not set
DBE_464.description: Death location status is not set where there is a date in the field.

DBE_465.title: Profile completeness - Death location Country not recognised
DBE_465.description: Country in the death location field isn't recognized (possible typo).

DBE_466.title: Profile completeness - Death location Country not official
DBE_466.description: Location is not entered in the official form for that country.

DBE_467.title: Profile completeness - Short Biography <500
DBE_467.description: Less than 500 characters of text in the Biography field.

DBE_468.title: Profile completeness - GEDCOM Junk
DBE_468.description: Biography contains GEDCOM sections that should not be on WikiTree (same as 853 but with different limits).

DBE_469.title: Profile completeness - Missing span Anchors
DBE_469.description: Profile uses in-page links that point to nonexistent HTML span anchors (e.g., with links to #name). Same as 944.

DBE_470.title: Profile completeness - Unused Span Anchors
DBE_470.description: Profile has HTML span anchors not used for in-page linking. Same as 945.

DBE_474.title: Profile completeness - Abbreviated Birth location Country not recommended
DBE_474.description: Birth location is abbreviated (exceptions: USA, UK). Same as 616.

DBE_475.title: Profile completeness - Abbreviated Death location Country not recommended
DBE_475.description: Death location is abbreviated (exceptions: USA, UK). Same as 646.

DBE_477.title: Profile completeness - Ambiguous Birth location Country not recommended
DBE_477.description: Birth location is ambiguous (often missing comma/incorrect separator). Same as 617.

DBE_478.title: Profile completeness - Ambiguous Death location Country not recommended
DBE_478.description: Death location is ambiguous (often missing comma/incorrect separator). Same as 647.

DBE_101.title: Birth in future
DBE_101.description: Birth date is in the future. The most common cause is a typo in the birth date.

DBE_102.title: Death in future
DBE_102.description: Death date is in the future. The most common cause is a typo in the death date.

DBE_103.title: Death before birth
DBE_103.description: Death date is prior to the birth date. Common causes are a typo in one of the dates or reversed birth and death dates. This error is checked only on profiles with both birth and death dates entered.

DBE_104.title: Too old
DBE_104.description: The person's age at death is over 110 years. A typo may cause it in the birth or death dates or by incorrect birth or death information. Only profiles with both birth and death dates entered are checked.

DBE_111.title: Died too young to be parent
DBE_111.description: This person was under ten years old at the death date, but has children without birth dates attached to the profile.

DBE_113.title: Duplicate in relatives
DBE_113.description: This person has the same relative appearing as two or more relatives on the their profile.

DBE_131.title: No Dates - No Dates on relatives - Open - Unknown Status
DBE_131.description: Both Birth and death dates are missing on this profile. There are no data on this profile or any attached relation profiles to estimate birth or death dates.

DBE_132.title: No Dates - No Dates on relatives - Open - Status Died
DBE_132.description: The profile information indicates this person is deceased, but both birth and death dates are missing. There are no data on this profile or any attached relation profiles to estimate birth or death dates.

DBE_133.title: No Dates - Dates on relatives - Open - Unknown Status
DBE_133.description: Both Birth and death dates are missing on this profile. There may be sufficient data on the attached relation profiles to estimate a birth or death date.

DBE_134.title: No Dates - Dates on relatives - Open - Status Died
DBE_134.description: This person is marked as dead, but all birth and death information is missing on this profile. There may be sufficient data on attached relation profiles to estimate a birth or death date.

DBE_205.title: Father is too young or not born
DBE_205.description: The father was either not born or under ten years old at this person's birth. Either a birth date or the relationship is incorrect.

DBE_206.title: Father is too old
DBE_206.description: The father is over 99 years old at the birth of this person. Either a birth or death date is incorrect, or the relationship is incorrect.

DBE_210.title: Father was dead before birth
DBE_210.description: This person's father died before their birth. In most cases, the person's birth date, the father's death date, or the relationship is wrong.

DBE_301.title: Mother is self
DBE_301.description: This person is their own mother. The relationship should be deleted or replaced with the correct mother.

DBE_305.title: Mother is too young or not born
DBE_305.description: The mother was either not born or under ten years old at this person's birth. Either a birth date or the relationship is incorrect.

DBE_306.title: Mother is too old
DBE_306.description: This person's mother was either over 99 years old or deceased at the birth of this person. Either a birth or death date is incorrect, or the relationship is incorrect.

DBE_307.title: Mother is also a child
DBE_307.description: This person is their own mother. The parent-child relationship should be deleted or replaced with the correct one.

DBE_310.title: Mother was dead before birth
DBE_310.description: This person's mother died before their birth. The person's birth date, the mother's death date, or the relationship is wrong.

DBE_401.title: Spouse is self
DBE_401.description: The person is married to him/her self. The marriage relationship should be removed and, if known, replaced with the correct one.

DBE_404.title: Marriage before birth
DBE_404.description: The person has a marriage date prior to their birth date. Either the birth or marriage dates are wrong, or both, or the relationship is incorrect. Enter the valid marriage or birth date if known. If the relationship is wrong, delete it, or enter the correct relationship.

DBE_405.title: Marriage too long after birth
DBE_405.description: The person's marriage date is more than 115 years after their birth date.

DBE_406.title: Marriage after death
DBE_406.description: The person has a marriage date after their death date. Either the death or marriage dates are wrong, or both, or the relationship is incorrect. Enter the valid marriage or death dated if known. If the relationship is wrong, delete it, or enter the correct relationship.

DBE_407.title: Lived too long after marriage
DBE_407.description: The person lived over 115 years after the marriage date. Either the death or marriage dates are wrong, or the relationship is incorrect. If the correct relationship, death, or marriage date is known, enter it.

DBE_410.title: Marriage in future
DBE_410.description: Marriage date is in the future. The most common cause is a typo in the birth date.

DBE_411.title: Marriage End Date in future
DBE_411.description: The marriage end date is in the future. Correct the date if it can be determined from a source.

DBE_412.title: Marriage End Date before Marriage Date
DBE_412.description: The marriage end date is before the marriage date. One or both dates may be incorrect.

DBE_413.title: Marriage too long
DBE_413.description: The difference between the marriage date and the marriage end date is more than 115 years.

DBE_414.title: Marriage End Date before Birth Date
DBE_414.description: The marriage end date is before the person's birth date. If the correct birth or marriage end date can be determined, fix it.

DBE_415.title: Marriage End Date too late
DBE_415.description: The difference between the person's birth date and their marriage end date is over 115 years.

DBE_416.title: Marriage End Date after Death Date
DBE_416.description: The marriage end date is after the person's death date. Either the marriage end date or death date is incorrect.

DBE_417.title: Death Date too long after Marriage End Date
DBE_417.description: The person's death and marriage end dates indicate that they lived over 115 years after the marriage end. One of these dates is incorrect.

DBE_105.title: Duplicate sibling
DBE_105.description: Another profile exists with the same full name, parents, birth, and death dates. Unless these two profiles are stillborn unnamed twins, they are probably duplicates and need merging. If you find they are not the same person, you can mark the error as a False Error after looking at both profiles and sources.

DBE_106.title: Duplicates between the global tree and unconnected
DBE_106.description: An unconnected profile exists with the same full name and birth and death dates as this profile. It is probably a duplicate, and the two profiles need merging. (Orphan profiles are ignored). If you find they are not the same person, you can mark the suggestion as a False Suggestion (do this for both profiles) after looking at both profiles and sources.

DBE_112.title: Person is father and mother
DBE_112.description: This person is father to some children and mother to others. Parentage should be corrected as appropriate.

DBE_201.title: Father is self
DBE_201.description: This person is their own father. The relationship should be deleted or replaced with the correct father.

DBE_202.title: Parents are same
DBE_202.description: This person's mother and father are the same person. The incorrect relationship should be deleted or replaced with the correct one.

DBE_203.title: Father is Female
DBE_203.description: The gender of the father of this person is female. Correct the gender of the father or replace the current father with the correct one (watch for a possible reversal of mother and father).

DBE_207.title: Father is also a child
DBE_207.description: This person is their own father. The parent-child relationship should be deleted or replaced with the correct one.

DBE_208.title: Father is also a spouse
DBE_208.description: This person's father is also her husband, but this is rarely true. The relationship should be deleted or replaced with the correct one.

DBE_209.title: Father is also a sibling
DBE_209.description: This person's father is also their sibling. If there is no 201 error on this profile, the problem is in the mother's children. Correct the mother's children. Type: Error

DBE_211.title: Duplicate sibling by Father
DBE_211.description: There is a profile with the same full name, birth, and death dates, and same father, but the mother is different. These two profiles may be duplicates; if so, they need merging.

DBE_213.title: Missing fathers DNA confirmation
DBE_213.description: Father is marked 'confirmed with DNA', but the words' paternal' and 'confirmed' do not appear in the biography. The DNA Project oversees this suggestion.

DBE_303.title: Mother is Male
DBE_303.description: The gender of the mother of this person is male. Correct the gender of the mother or replace the current mother with the correct one. (watch for a possible reversal of mother and father) .

DBE_308.title: Mother is also a spouse
DBE_308.description: This person's mother is also his wife, which is rarely true. The relationship should be removed or replaced with the correct spouse.

DBE_309.title: Mother is also a sibling
DBE_309.description: This person's mother is also their sibling. If there is no 301 error on this profile, the problem is in the father's children. Correct the father's children.

DBE_311.title: Duplicate sibling by Mother
DBE_311.description: There is a profile with the same full name, birth, and death dates, and same mother, but the mother is different. These two profiles may be duplicates; if so, after careful comparison, they need merging.

DBE_313.title: Missing mothers DNA confirmation
DBE_313.description: Mother is marked 'confirmed with DNA,' but the words' maternal' and 'confirmed' do not appear in the biography. The DNA Project oversees this suggestion.

DBE_408.title: Multiple marriages on same day
DBE_408.description: The person married more than one spouse on the same day. If one marriage date is incorrect, fix it, or if the spouses are duplicates, merge them.

DBE_409.title: Marriage to duplicate person
DBE_409.description: The person married more than one person with the same name. If the spouses are duplicates, merge them.

DBE_418.title: Spouse is a sibling
DBE_418.description: The person's spouse has one of the same parents, while not impossible, is unlikely. Correct when the problem is determined.

DBE_419.title: Unmarried parents with no marriages
DBE_419.description: These parents have a common child, but no marriage is recorded for them, usually caused by older faulty gedcom imports. Try to find a marriage record and enter the marriage. If one can't be found, note that in the Research Notes section.

DBE_420.title: Unmarried parents with other marriages
DBE_420.description: These parents have a common child, but no marriage between them is recorded, although other marriages are listed. The common cause is older faulty gedcom imports. Try to find the marriage record and enter the marriage details. Note that in the Research Notes section, if one cannot be found. Merges may be needed for the "other" marriage.

DBE_421.title: Hidden marriage on public or open profiles
DBE_421.description: There is a hidden marriage between the two persons that is not viewable on the profile. That shouldn't be the case on public and opened profiles. The cause is not completely understanding how to use the check box when entering the marriage information. Uncheck the check box on edit marriage page.

DBE_901.title: Unconnected empty public profile
DBE_901.description: This public profile has no relations - parents, children, and marriage and no birth and death date or location data. This error is Connectors Project-related is not usually part of the Data Doctors work.

DBE_902.title: Unconnected empty open profile
DBE_902.description: This open profile has no relations - parents, children, and marriage and no birth and death date or location data. This error is Connectors Project-related is not usually part of the Data Doctors work.

DBE_511.title: Replaced
DBE_511.description: This suggestion has been replaced by 7x7 suggestions (i.e. 717, 727, etc.) described below. The video applies to the replacement suggestions. Substitute the field referenced for those suggestions.

DBE_711.title: Separator in prefix
DBE_711.description: There is a separator in the prefix field. Examples include "/", "-", ",", "(" and ")". Separators should normally not be used in the prefix field. See suggestion description for details.

DBE_712.title: Number in prefix
DBE_712.description: There is a number in the prefix field. Numbers should not normally be used in the prefix. See suggestion description for details.

DBE_713.title: Suffix in prefix
DBE_713.description: The contents of the prefix field should normally be in the suffix field. See suggestion description for details.

DBE_714.title: Wrong word in prefix
DBE_714.description: A word not normally used as a prefix is in the prefix field. See error description for details.

DBE_715.title: Wrong character in Prefix
DBE_715.description: There is unusual character in the prefix field.

DBE_717.title: Unique name in Prefix
DBE_717.description: The prefix of this profile is unique on WikiTree which could indicate a misspelled prefix.

DBE_721.title: Separator in first name
DBE_721.description: There is a separator in the first name field. Examples include "/", "-", ",", "(" and ")". Separators should normally not be used in the first name field. See error description for details.

DBE_722.title: Number in first name
DBE_722.description: There is a number in the first name field. Numbers should not normally be used in the first name. See error description for details.

DBE_723.title: Prefix in first name
DBE_723.description: The first name field contains a term normally considered a prefix. See error description for details.

DBE_724.title: Wrong word in first name
DBE_724.description: A word not normally used as a name is in the first name field. See error description for details.

DBE_725.title: Wrong character in first name
DBE_725.description: A character not normally used in a name is in the first name field. See error description for details.

DBE_727.title: Unique name in First Name
DBE_727.description: First Name of this profile is unique on WikiTree. This could be a misspelled First Name.

DBE_731.title: Separator in preferred name
DBE_731.description: There is a separator in the preferred name field. Examples include "/", "-", ",", "(" and ")". Separators should normally not be used in the preferred name field. See error description for details.

DBE_732.title: Number in preferred name
DBE_732.description: There is a number in the preferred name field. Numbers should not normally be used in the preferred name. See error description for details.

DBE_733.title: Prefix in preferred name
DBE_733.description: The preferred name field contains a term normally considered a prefix. See error description for details.

DBE_734.title: Wrong word in preferred name
DBE_734.description: A word not normally used as a name is in the preferred name field. See error description for details.

DBE_735.title: Wrong character in preferred name
DBE_735.description: A character not normally used in a name is in the preferred name field. See error description for details.

DBE_737.title: Unique name in Preferred Name
DBE_737.description: The preferred name of this profile is unique on WikiTree which could be a misspelled name.

DBE_741.title: Separator in middle name
DBE_741.description: There is a separator in the middle name field. Examples include "/", "-", ",", "(" and ")". Separators should normally not be used in the middle name field. See error description for details.

DBE_742.title: Number in middle name
DBE_742.description: There is a number in the middle name field. Numbers should not normally be used in the middle name. See error description for details.

DBE_743.title: Prefix in middle name
DBE_743.description: The middle name field contains a term normally considered a prefix. See suggestion description for details.

DBE_744.title: Wrong word in middle name
DBE_744.description: A word not normally used as a name is in the middle name field. See error description for details.

DBE_745.title: Wrong character in middle name
DBE_745.description: A character not normally used in a name is in the middle name field. See error description for details.

DBE_747.title: Unique name in Middle Name
DBE_747.description: The middle name of this profile is unique on WikiTree which could be a misspelled name.

DBE_749.title: Middle Name used in used in some areas
DBE_749.description: The middle name field contains a name for a person born in a region that doesn't have a concept of a middle name. This is easy for those familiar with those regions and research in that area.

DBE_751.title: Separator in nicknames
DBE_751.description: There is a separator in the nicknames field. Examples include "/", "-", ",", "(" and ")". Separators should normally not be used in the nicknames field. See error description for details.

DBE_752.title: Number in nicknames
DBE_752.description: There is a number in the nicknames field. Nicknames don't use numbers in the nicknames. See error description for details.

DBE_753.title: Prefix in nicknames
DBE_753.description: The nicknames field contains a term normally considered a prefix. See suggestion description for details.

DBE_754.title: Wrong word in nicknames
DBE_754.description: A word not normally used as a name is in the nicknames field. See suggestion description for details.

DBE_755.title: Wrong character in Nicknames
DBE_755.description: There is an unusual character in the nicknames field.

DBE_757.title: Unique name in Nicknames
DBE_757.description: Suffix of this profile is unique on WikiTree. This could be a misspelled Suffix.

DBE_761.title: Separator in suffix
DBE_761.description: There is a separator in the suffix field. Examples include "/", "-", ",", "(" and ")". Separators should normally not be used in the suffix field. See error description for details.

DBE_762.title: Number in suffix
DBE_762.description: There is a number in the suffix field. Numbers should not normally be used in the suffix. See error description for details.

DBE_763.title: Prefix in suffix
DBE_763.description: The suffix field contains a term normally considered a prefix. See error description for details.

DBE_764.title: Wrong word in suffix
DBE_764.description: A word not normally used as a name is in the suffix field. See error description for details.

DBE_765.title: Wrong character in suffix
DBE_765.description: In Suffix there is unusual character.

DBE_767.title: Unique name in Suffix
DBE_767.description: Suffix of this profile is unique on WikiTree. This could be a misspelled Suffix.

DBE_771.title: Separator in last name at birth
DBE_771.description: There is a separator in the last name at birth field. Examples include "/", "-", ",", "(" and ")". Separators should normally not be used in the last name at birth field. See error description for details.

DBE_772.title: Number in Last Name at Birth
DBE_772.description: The last name at birth contains a number.

DBE_773.title: Prefix in last name at birth
DBE_773.description: The last name at birth field contains a term normally considered a prefix. See suggestion description for details.

DBE_774.title: Wrong word in last name at birth
DBE_774.description: A word not normally used as a name is in the last name at birth field. See error description for details.

DBE_775.title: Wrong character in last name at birth
DBE_775.description: A character not normally used in a name is in the last name at birth field. See error description for details.

DBE_777.title: Unique name in Last Name at Birth
DBE_777.description: Last Name at Birth of this profile is unique on WikiTree. This could be a misspelled Last Name at Birth.

DBE_778.title: Period in the Last Name at Birth
DBE_778.description: Last name at Birth field contains a period which is not allowed by WikiTree guidelines. See suggestion description for details.

DBE_781.title: Separator in current last name
DBE_781.description: There is a separator in the current last name field. Examples include "/", "-", ",", "(" and ")". Separators should normally not be used in the current last name field. See error description for details.

DBE_782.title: Number in current last name
DBE_782.description: In Current Last name numbers have been found that indicates an error.

DBE_783.title: Prefix in current last name
DBE_783.description: The current last name field contains a term normally considered a prefix. See error description for details.

DBE_784.title: Wrong word in current last name
DBE_784.description: A word not normally used as a name is in the current last name field. See suggestion description for details.

DBE_785.title: Wrong character in current last name
DBE_785.description: A character not normally used in a name is in the current last name field. See suggestion description for details.

DBE_787.title: Unique name in Current Last Name
DBE_787.description: Current Last Name of this profile is unique on WikiTree. This could be a misspelled Current Last Name.

DBE_788.title: Period in Current Last Name
DBE_788.description: A period is found in the Current Last Name field which is not allowed by WikiTree guidelines. See suggestion description for details.
